chapters.label: Extra time
chapters.text: Johannesburg, 2010. The World Cup final is still nil nil, deep in extra time. Spain break forward, the ball bounces loose, and Cesc Fàbregas finds Andrés Iniesta in space.

chapters.label: The pass
chapters.text: Watch Fàbregas again. He lifts his head, sees Iniesta alone on the right, and slides the ball into his path. One touch, then a shot, into the corner! Spain are world champions!

chapters.label: Head up
chapters.text: Want to pass like Fàbregas? Stay calm, even when your legs are tired. Look up before the ball arrives. Then pass into your teammate’s path, not at his feet.
